description.$value: Component tokens for the Card molecule — spacing, size, color (bg, border, fg, with inverse pairs), typography, border radius and border width. States (interaction, availability, selection, focus) are Figma component variants, so they have no keys here.

padding_top.$description: Top padding of the content area below the image.

padding_right.$description: Right padding of the content area. Same as the left padding so the text block sits centered.

padding_bottom.$description: Bottom padding of the content area, below the last slot (footer or buttons).

padding_left.$description: Left padding of the content area. Same as the right padding so the text block sits centered.

row_gap.$description: Vertical gap between the slots of the content area: alert, header, text, footer and buttons.

col_gap.$description: Horizontal gap between the header icon or avatar and the title block.
Horizontal gap between the left and the right footer text.
Horizontal gap between the buttons in the card button group.

height.$description: Default height of the image slot. The image fills the full card width.

width.$description: Width and height of the header avatar or icon.

bg_inverse.$description: Background color of the card on a flipped surface.

border_inverse.$description: Border color of the card on a flipped surface.

fg.$description: Color of the title and the body text.

fg_inverse.$description: Color of the title and the body text on a flipped surface.

fg_subtle.$description: Color of the subtitle and the footer text.

fg_subtle_inverse.$description: Color of the subtitle and the footer text on a flipped surface.

border_radius.$description: Corner radius of the card. The image slot is clipped to it.

border_width.$description: Border width of the card surface.
